reviews.title: Ai ahead of real world
reviews.text: Ai is pushing these protein options as if they aren’t customizations so recipes don’t match ingredients.

reviews.title: Sort the glitches out
reviews.text: Good service, awful app - constantly glitches so that you can’t actually place orders on the date you want or access the full menu.

reviews.title: Hello Salmonella
reviews.text: Got the worst case of food poisoning I’ve ever had in my life. Literally almost killed me. It bottomed out my potassium levels to near fatal. Thankfully, I got to an urgent care in time. I will never ever get anything from this company again.

reviews.title: They order for you again your will
reviews.text: I have had a box I don’t want ordered and charged to my card and they will not refund the fraudulent charge

reviews.title: Wiederholt Probleme mit der Pausierung – sehr enttäuschender Kundenservice!
reviews.text:
Leider ist es jetzt schon zum wiederholten Mal passiert, dass ich trotz rechtzeitiger Pausierung der kommenden Woche einfach fünf Gerichte geliefert bekomme, die ich nicht einmal selbst ausgesucht habe! Die Woche war in der App eindeutig rot als pausiert markiert – trotzdem wird die Lieferung einfach durchgeführt.

Nach Kontaktaufnahme mit dem Kundenservice hieß es nur, eine Stornierung sei nicht mehr möglich. Kundenorientierung sieht für mich definitiv anders aus! Besonders ärgerlich ist das, wenn man in der betreffenden Woche überhaupt nicht zu Hause ist.

Bereits letzte Woche hatte ich vergessen, die Lieferung zu pausieren. Das war natürlich mein Fehler, keine Frage. Allerdings habe ich in der App ausdrücklich „Vital & Gesund“ als Vorliebe hinterlegt und bekomme trotzdem Gerichte mit teilweise rund 1.000 kcal. Auch das passt für mich überhaupt nicht zusammen.

Wir überlegen mittlerweile ernsthaft, unser Abo zu kündigen und zu einem anderen Anbieter zu wechseln. Schade eigentlich, denn die Grundidee ist gut. Aber wenn weder die Pausierung zuverlässig funktioniert noch der Kundenservice eine vernünftige Lösung anbietet, verliert man irgendwann einfach das Vertrauen.

So kann ich den Anbieter leider nicht mehr guten Gewissens weiterempfehlen.

reviews.title: Gutschein-Einlösung grenzt an Betrug
reviews.text:
Ich habe als ich mich bei HelloFresh angemeldet habe drei Gutscheine (je 50€) eingelöst. Nachdem ich die Einlösung nicht direkt gecheckt habe, musste ich jetzt feststellen, dass mir jeweils nur 44,51€ gutgeschrieben wurde.

Laut Kundenservice wurde hierbei wohl „der Versand“ abgezogen. Wobei der Kundenservice dabei ebenso verwirrt schien wie ich. Zuerst hieß es, dass das so in den AGB steht (stimmt nicht!), dann dass das die Versandkosten für den Gutschein selbst waren (Onlinegutschein, stimmt also auch nicht). Dann, dass mir der Versand für zukünftige Bestellungen gutgeschrieben wird (stimmt nicht, und stimmt auch nicht mit den 5,99€ pro Box überein), und dann, dass damit der Versand der letzten Boxen übernommen worden sei. Ob das stimmt, kann ich leider nicht nachvollziehen, allerdings wurde mir bei den Bestellungen der Versand als „gratis“ angezeigt. Wenn ich den jetzt also hintenrum über von mir bezahlte Gutscheine zahle finde ich das nahe am Betrug.

Für einen der drei Gutscheine wurden mir die fehlenden 5,49€ nach Beschwerde gutgeschrieben, für die anderen nicht. Warum? Leider auch hier keinerlei Transparenz.

Die Gutscheineinlösung ist leider ebenso intransparent. Pro Bestellung muss man hier das Guthaben als Zahlungsmethode wählen, was auch immer nur für die nächste Bestellung gilt.
Es wird also ganz offensichtlich versucht, Guthaben zu erhalten, so dass die Kunden länger bei HelloFresh bleiben „müssen“.

Alles in allem wäre ich gar nicht mal unzufrieden mit HelloFres

reviews.title: Filter sind teilweise falsch
reviews.text: Bislang war ich recht zufrieden. Seit einiger Zeit ärgert mich, dass sich die veganen Gerichte zu oft wiederholen. Außerdem, und noch viel wichtiger: nicht-vegane Gerichte zB mit Fisch und Honig sind als vegan gekennzeichnet, oder es soll Milch hinzugefügt werden.

reviews.title: Totale SCHIMMEL Katastrophe!!
reviews.text: Die Qualität der Lebensmittel ist unterirdisch! Zum Teil kommen die Zutaten verschimmelt beim Kunden an! Der Kundenservice zeigt wenig Verständnis..

reviews.title: Do not order from them!
reviews.text: I’ve never truly had a bad experience with a company/had to write a bad review for anything ever. The app is misleading and regardless of me repeatedly putting in my gluten allergy they continued to send me/attempt to send me meals that “fit my needs” that almost all had gluten. They never fulfilled the sign on bonus and had me spend hours on the phone and over email communicating with representatives only to not have the offer fulfilled even when I had the proof submitted that I met the qualifications? The service is a money scam

reviews.title: Scam app
reviews.text: They will take your money not send you food then make it impossible to cancel subscription. Absolutely predatory service. Do not make the mistake I made.

reviews.text: After years if going through the works with these guys. They went from great to garbage. Nowadays they constantly substitute your expensive meat choices with cheap chicken almost every week. Not to mention the constantly burst meat bags and missing ingredients, or missing cooking sheets, or recipe sheets for entirely different meals. Do not order or work with hello fresh youll be nothing but disappointed, and you can make these meals for much cheaper

reviews.title: kind of scummy
reviews.text: ok first of all i have a like 120 box streak so when i say this take that into account: hellofresh recently changed how gift cards are applied and in a way that is really scummy. i have like 200 euros on my account but its not possible to automatically apply it to orders. instead i have to manually apply it each week and only withon a specific timeframe (after the previous week was booked off but before current week). this is ridiculous behavior which is obviously done to intentionally prevent people feom using real money theyve spent. absolute disgrace.

reviews.title: Consistent until it’s not
reviews.text: I have used hello fresh for 2 years now and it’s been a great solution. Lately it’s been difficult because they can’t seem to send all of my order. I’ve tried talking to the agents the stupid ai and their app has had a glitch and now I’ve lost money

reviews.title: Cancelled my subscription
reviews.text: The app forces you to go through an AI bot if you have any problems. The meals are ok but the ingredients aren’t particularly fresh. I probably would have stuck with the subscription out of convenience but the customer service was too frustrating. I was charged for a week I won’t be in town despite letting them know ahead of time.

reviews.title: Wrong and missing items
reviews.text: What we got correct was great but the customer service is poor for missing and incorrect items. I had one incorrect meat and one missing all together. They gave me a credit on my account that I canceled lol

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: So disappointed. They are unable to deliver to my house and won’t refund my money for the box because it is in delivery status. Seems a little unfair.

reviews.title: They just don’t care
reviews.text: I have had HelloFresh for a year and before then I had them one time before for about a year also. Recently, I’ve noticed the packaging is getting worse. Produce not as good as it used to be. And recently, I had not picked my own meals, but the system at automatically filled the order for the week. I get three meals for two people a week at $90 with tax so that’s about $30 for a meal for two. They decided that this week two of the meals will be vegetarian and when you look at the ingredient list, you know you’re getting ripped off. I’ve never once ordered a vegetarian meal so I don’t know why they would feel that this would’ve been a good automatic selection. when I contacted customer service about it, I was pretty much told too bad. You didn’t fill out the change in time. After spending about $5000 with this company and they’re not willing to work with me in any sort of way. That says a lot about this company. I just canceled my subscription and I won’t be back. You shouldn’t waste your time either.

reviews.title: Customer service is terrible
reviews.text: The customer service is terrible, the chat constantly disconnects and every time it reconnects I need to start over. About 50% of deliveries with eggs have been delivered with eggs cracked and spilled all over the box.

reviews.title: don’t do it
reviews.text: food was mediocre even from a unbiased review of someone who has been spam called by this company daily even after asking to get my number removed multiple times

reviews.title: Skip a week but crash
reviews.text: Every time I go to the page that skips a weeks delivery the app just crashes every time. It been like this at least for a few months I’ve had to go to the desktop site to make it work

reviews.title: Account Activation = Automatic Box/Charge
reviews.text:
I downloaded the app and activated an account just to browse the boxes.  I decided I wasn't interested and canceled the subscription within 30 minutes.  To my great surprise, I received a box today.  I checked and I was charged for the box.  I called customer service twice and was told that my cancellation date missed the cutoff date for the box.  I could not possibly have met the cutoff date, since I didn't activate and cancel until after it.

TLDR; Activation of account resulted in automatic charge.  Don’t download the app to browse boxes like I did.

reviews.title: Scummy
reviews.text: Very frustrating trying to cancel they use misleading graphic design to they to trick you into clicking the wrong button, very scummy

reviews.title: Stole from my family
reviews.text: The game is: you put your card in and they start charging you weekly no matter what. It doesn’t matter if you didn’t hit “order”, and it doesn’t matter how much you call and chat with them (always a call center where communication is difficult, they can’t find this extra charge or that one, and their resolution team, always a random guy posed as “Art”) you won’t get any money back. They stole $260 from us and we never ordered anything to begin with. Don’t bother calling or chatting with their customer service, to get you frustrated and wasting time is the point of their game. You must go through your bank and dispute. Hope this helps someone make the choice not to bother with them.

reviews.title: Achtung
reviews.text:
Wir haben unseren HelloFresh-Account am 20. September
gekündigt und gingen davon aus, dass damit keine weiteren Lieferungen erfolgen. Trotzdem wurde noch eine Box geliefert, obwohl wir diese nicht bewusst bestellt hatten.
Auf die mögliche Lieferung wurde in der Kündigungsbestätigung nur beiläufig hingewiesen. Ein klarer Hinweis, dass die Box separat storniert werden muss, fehlte.
Für mich ist das intransparent und nicht kundenfreundlich. Daher leider nur 1 Stern.

reviews.title: App turned awful
reviews.text: Used to be so good, now it’s bloated and impossible to do what you want

reviews.title: Kleine Bugs und mangelnde Übersichtlichkeit
reviews.text:
Wenn man einmalig einen anderen Liefertag mit Zusatzgebühr wählt und sich anschließend doch wieder für den ursprünglichen Liefertag ohne Zusatzgebühr entscheidet, wird die Gebühr trotzdem berechnet.

Wenn man ein Add-on zu einem Hauptgericht hinzufügt und das Hauptgericht anschließend doch wieder entfernt, bleibt das Add-on erhalten und lässt sich nicht mehr abwählen („This product can only be modified together with the main recipe.“).

Davon abgesehen wird die App leider immer unübersichtlicher. In einer früheren Version konnte man anstehende Lieferungen in einer horizontalen Leiste sehen und auch direkt dort bearbeiten. Das ist inzwischen nicht mehr möglich. Die Liste mit den anstehenden Lieferungen ist unübersichtlich und gefühlt schwer änderbar geworden.

reviews.title: Tired of these pointless updates!!
reviews.text: I’m tired of being forced to update EVERY TIME I OPEN THE APP!

reviews.title: Predatory App Bugs
reviews.text: The app is apparently buggy on some phones. I selected “skip” for my next meal in the app and was charged anyway. So I used the “chat now” feature and was told that I had in fact skipped a week but it couldn’t tell me which week was skipped. When I called customer service they said there was no skip at all and that a refund was impossible.

reviews.title: Nie wieder
reviews.text: Zum ersten Mal bestellt. Erst wurde ein falsches Lieferdatum genannt, dann drei Gerichte angekündigt  welche ich nicht ausgewählt hatte. Stornieren war nicht mehr möglich. Nach langem hin und her wurde dann auf Kulanz doch storniert. Nie  wieder HelloFresh.

reviews.title: Please Beware!!
reviews.text:
Horrible app, horrible company, and they steal your money! I have been constantly fighting with Hello Fresh about my account cancellation and still getting charged, they tell me they have no info and that should not be happening, yet every time I dispute a charge they supposedly have information that goes against me???
But every time I ask them they sayẠạ that's our bad we have no record of charges." Done with this BS!! Do yourself a favor and do not try out HelloFresh, you'll be out $100 + and get zero boxes....

reviews.text: I’ve been using HelloFresh for about five years now. I no longer need it as my household size has decreased,  shipping has increased and portions seem to be smaller. It just makes sense to cancel. Been trying to cancel my subscription for two days and the only link to the cancellation page is not working.

reviews.title: Terrible Company
reviews.text: Does not care about its customers at all. Genuinely will not try to help you or anything. Do not order from them.

reviews.title: PREDATORY CANCELLATION SCHEME
reviews.text:
BE AWARE
•if you cancel your account, they will attempt to offer 50% off your next order and ask for your permission to reactivate your account. THEY WILL CHARGE YOU without your consent and send you an unauthorized box. This company is predatory, has poor ingredients and issues with boxes (packing issues, SMELLY ROTTEN MEATS). reviews.title: Geen recept keuzes kunnen maken
reviews.text: Sinds enige tijd kan ik geen recepten meer wijzigen via de app. Ik krijg een error melding. De helpdesk gebeld maar ook zij weten niet waarom de app bij mij niet goed werkt. Alleen via de website werkt alles nog naar behoren. Ik hoop dat de error snel ontdekt wordt in de app.

reviews.title: Pretty disappointed
reviews.text:
This is pretty poor. I recently went back and gave it a go after trying hello fresh previously and being let down. I swore not to come back as the service was pretty poor last time. However, I was talked into coming back by one of their salesmen who said they’d fixed all issues. 

So I was optimistic. Unfortunately, first delivery and multiple ingredients missing.
Try to report this and I’m placed on hold and waiting for an agent. I write this after becoming frustrated at waiting. 
Gousto, their main competitor - I had the same issue last week with missing ingredients, but Gousto sorted it straight away. No hold, no wait, just straight forward report and refund using the app. No air chat, no waiting for an agent. Just decent service. I’m left regretting giving hello fresh one more chance.

reviews.title: Very hard to cancel
reviews.text: It is very hard to cancel from the app and they do not refund appropriately for spoiled ingredients.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: It’s impossible to use if you don’t speak German. The latest update also removed pictures of the cooking process, so now I even can’t see whether I have to bake it (which I avoid), blend (the same) or just fry it before I decide to add meal to my basket. It makes the app almost useless for me, as I could order something I won’t be able to cook at home. If it’s too complex to introduce Eng version of the app, why not keep the images or add simple icons so it’s clear for everyone? 👿

reviews.title: Over charged
reviews.text: I canceled my service, but they still proceeded to send a box of food. The box contain steak. The steak was busted open, and there was steak blood all over the entire package. It smiled so awful. Additionally, they’re trying to bill me for this package they sent without billing me and they also added a charge for some gourmet lunch box that I have no idea what they’re talking about cause not only did I not receive it I never ordered it. I have tried reaching out to customer service only to get put on hold or hung up on or the chat freeze.  I’m so frustrated with this whole situation.   They are trying to charge me about $170 for ruined food, and something I did not order or receive.

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: The worst customer service. Good luck trying to get in contact with them

reviews.title: Too hot for shipping
reviews.text:
Shipping food during a heatwave, especially with additional heat warnings in effect, feels far too risky for me. I recently experienced food poisoning from spoiled beef—not HelloFresh. To be absolutely clear, I did not become sick from HelloFresh. However, I did discard the raw chicken included in this box because I was not comfortable taking any chances with food safety.

As a result, I’m particularly cautious about perishable food being exposed to extreme temperatures during shipping. I was not comfortable with this box being shipped from Texas and potentially sitting inside a hot delivery truck for most of the day before arriving at my home in the late afternoon. Given the extreme temperatures, I simply do not feel confident that the food was maintained at a safe temperature throughout the delivery.

Ultimately, this was a $29.00 mistake on my part, but given my recent experience with food poisoning, I believe being cautious about the safety of perishable food is completely justified.

reviews.title: 1 star – Extremely disappointing customer service
reviews.text:
I’ve been on and off with HelloFresh for years, but after this experience I absolutely will not be returning.

I cancelled my subscription 4 days before going on holiday, but apparently HelloFresh requires 5 days’ notice. I called them 2 days before the delivery to explain that I was away and had cancelled, but because I had apparently missed the cut-off by just a few hours, they refused to stop the box.

£70 was taken from my account for a box I hadn’t chosen or wanted. I was hoping HelloFresh would show a bit of goodwill given the circumstances, but instead I had to contact them to try to resolve it. I was offered goodwill gestures totalling £34, but I have not received that refund yet. This still leaves me paying for a box that I had tried to cancel before it was delivered.

My friend was looking after my dog while I was away and received the box. When she opened it, it was missing fish, meat, tomatoes, onions and peppers. She contacted HelloFresh again and was offered compensation for the missing ingredients, but I have not received that refund yet either.

What makes the whole situation even more frustrating is that because I had cancelled, I hadn’t selected the recipes. HelloFresh simply sent whatever meals they decided to send, and not one of them was something that I, my family or even my friend would have chosen or wanted to eat.

If you’re going to send a box that the customer hasn’t selected, you’d think you might at least send some of your more popular meals. Inst

reviews.text: De app is totaal onbruikbaar op een iPad. Menu’s zijn niet aan te passen en de helft van de tijd komt er een melding dat de inhoud niet geladen kan worden. Jammer.

reviews.text: Was soll ich mit der App wenn ich seit Wochen meine Menüs nicht mehr anpassen kann und der Support nur helfen kann mit - vielleicht im Browser? Ernst gemeint oder kann die App jetzt weg?

reviews.title: Customer since 2014. Disappointed
reviews.text: Time to move on. Quality is very inconsistent, while the value is no longer there.

reviews.title: Not all it’s cracked up to be
reviews.text:
The recipes are fine, but the cost just doesn’t justify not shopping for groceries yourself. At full price, it’s healthier, but not cheaper, than fast food.

It’s difficult enough to cancel that they want you to just keep skipping if you don’t want it anymore bc if you forget to skip, looks like you’re getting more food.

Cancelled and deleted as soon as they associated with Meta Ray Bans.

reviews.title: They have destroyed themselves
reviews.text: I’ve used hello fresh since 2021? I think and over the last one to two years the decline in quality, customer service, app accessibility, ease of use and don’t get me started on how small the portion sizes have gotten has been absolutely ridiculous. They should be ashamed of themselves. You’re better off putting up with grocery stores

reviews.title: Annoying pop up won’t leave
reviews.text: Notifications about adding more items for free shipping or deals won’t go away when you are trying to select items on the app making the space much smaller. Needs to be able to go away

reviews.title: QUALITY ONLY
reviews.text: Quality of meat has plummeted. We were relying on beef & ground turkey meals because chicken is literal scraps! After the beef and turkey meat smelled and would cook roughly we chose to end our membership. One good thing is I kept most recipe cards so I can tweak the recipe.

reviews.title: Warum Lieblingsgerichte entfernen?
reviews.text:
Ugh HelloFresh. Wieso verschlimmbessert man denn die App ständig. Jetzt wurden alle Gerichte geändert und meine bewerteten Gerichte werden nicht mehr ganz oben angezeigt wo ich sie super schnell auswählen konnte wenn sie verfügbar waren. 
Ich will doch nicht jede Woche durch hunderte Gerichte scrollen wenn ich eh immer die selben auswähle. 
Und das Matching… puuuh. 3 Wochen hintereinander entferne ich ein spezielles Gericht aus den vorgeschlagenen und in der 4. Woche wählt ihr es einfach wieder als vorgeschlagenes Gericht. Das ist ja schon penetrant. 

Und wo sind denn die ganzen Tofu Gerichte? Ich sehe gar keine mehr. Also irgendwas ist in den letzten 2 Wochen passiert mit euch.

reviews.title: Slechte app
reviews.text: App crasht, recepten kiezen (verwijderen/toevoegen) lukt niet. Via de website gaat goed, maar in de app werkt het niet. Laatste versie, ook van iOS.

reviews.title: Food is good, App is not
reviews.text: We have been happy Hello Fresh customers for almost 3 years. We love the food. Quality is high and delivery is reliable. The app, however, just keeps getting worse and worse. It is cluttered with distractions and pop-ups designed to up-sell you every week. I just want to pick my damn meals. I don’t want to add extras. I don’t want to refer a friend for a “free meal”. I don’t want to click 5 times to confirm my selection. I don’t want to learn a new app interface every 3 months. I just want to pick my food in peace. Get out of your own way.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: No meals load and says “app not working properly” and customer service doesn’t really care. Not paying for a subscription where I cannot open the menu.

reviews.title: Die Gerichte sind gut und lecker aber die App ist schrecklich
reviews.text:
App user experience ist auf niedrigstem Niveau. Alles ist verbuggt und man kann die App kaum ohne irgend welche Software Fehler bedienen. Mal kann ich gar nichts bearbeiten, dann kann ich keine Gerichte ändern, dann kann man die Voreinstellungen und Präferenzen nicht speichern oder es werden falsche Gerichte ausgewählt und in der App kann man sie nicht anpassen weil die App es einfach nicht zu lässt.

Also da muss dringend nachgebessert werden, sonst ist das Essen lecker, die Rezepte abwechslungsreich und wenn man eine Zutat fehlt, ist der Support ganz okay.

reviews.title: Na update geen fijne weergave menu
reviews.text: Sinds laatste update is menu (dus wat je voor volgende week wil bestellen) gewijzigd, met nogal niche filters zoals “te vermijden ingrediënten” terwijl de oude categorieën (“snel” “familie”) weg zijn gehaald. Heel onhandig om nu menu door te nemen, kost op deze manier veel meer tijd, ben het overzicht kwijt. Ook gerechten selecteren gaat slecht, de voorgeselecteerde gerechten krijg je niet zomaar verwijderd uit je mandje, die schieten weer terug.

reviews.title: Ständig kaputt
reviews.text: Ich hatte bereits das Problem, dass die App so kaputt war, dass ich sie neu installieren musste, damit sie wieder halbwegs funktioniert. Aktuell habe ich das Problem, dass ich per App nicht in der Lage bin, meine gebuchten Gerichte zu ändern. Die gebuchten Gerichte kann ich nicht entfernen. Der Button sagt mir hinzufügen, was nicht geht, weil die Anzahl der gebuchten Gerichte erreicht ist. Einfach unbenutzbar. Über die Webseite klappt das, aber ich möchte nicht auf die Webseite gehen und mich einloggen um wöchentlich meine Gerichte zu ändern.

reviews.title: Great idea poor execution
reviews.text: We were customers years ago and stopped because we had kids, one of whom was very picky so he wouldn’t eat the meals. They’re older now so we started back up. Our second order we felt something off when we all felt sick and opened the second meal in the order and found the chicken was rotten. Checked the other bag and same issue. The convenience is awesome but not worth poor packaging and QC that leads to illness.

reviews.title: App keeps crashing
reviews.text: I like hello fresh, but the app makes it a real struggle to order. The support team is fast in replying but did not really try to resolve the issue…

reviews.title: Kan niets wijzigen
reviews.text: Ik kan niets wijzigen in de app. Om andere maaltijden te kiezen, moet je er eerst een verwijderen. Dat lukt nergens en op geen enkele manier in de app. Moet alsnog naar de website toe 🙄🙁

reviews.title: Beware of Overcharging
reviews.text: I was a customer for a while and then cancelled to save money. They sent me a discount code in the mail so I signed back up with that code and selected my meals. I was excited to sign back up, selected more meals than usual (we usually do three or four, I picked out five because the discount was over 50% on the first box). I confirmed my order and even picked out the next few weeks of meals. Then a few days passed and I checked my bank statement. I was charged almost double the amount I had seen on the app when I confirmed my order. Instead of 50%+ the discount was something like 10%. My order had been less than $100 altogether with the discount, the charges on my bank statement were almost $160. I contacted HelloFresh thinking it was a mistake and we’d just resolve it and move on. Wrong. I’ve been a customer for almost a year, received ten boxes or so, and when I reached out about the charges the agent said because it was past the cutoff to cancel the box, there was nothing they could do about the charges. They said they understood my frustration but the box was already being packed and no refunds were possible, even though the agent acknowledged that I was sent a specific discount in the mail, applied it, and then was charged with a different, much smaller discount. In the end I said ok I guess I’ll just cancel, I’m really disappointed that I was charged an amount I didn’t agree to and that there is nothing you can do and the agent said ok, I can help you with that cancella

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
Someone came to my house and persuaded me to sign up for my first HelloFresh orders, presenting the discount as a good introductory offer.

Within about five seconds of checking online afterwards, I found I could have received a significantly better introductory deal simply by signing up online.

It feels pretty poor to have door-to-door salespeople actively upselling new customers onto a worse deal than the one HelloFresh is openly offering online. I came away feeling misled rather than welcomed as a new customer, and it has left a really bad taste.

reviews.title: The mighty has fallen
reviews.text: This used to be a great service. Quality has really fallen. And as it’s fallen the app has made it harder and harder to report problems. It’s a shame, because I really did enjoy HelloFresh once upon a time.

reviews.title: Leider immer wieder enttäuscht
reviews.text: Nun ist es sicher das zehnte Mal dass ich vergammelte oder gar keine Zutaten bekommen habe. Wenn man spät abends hungrig das kochen anfängt. Bringen auch 10 Cent Erstattung nichts wenn man das ganze Gericht nicht kochen kann.

reviews.title: Skipping weeks was removed from app
reviews.text: HelloFresh updated their iOS app to remove the ability for users to “skip” a week.  Of course the app still lets you “unskip” a week, but now you have to go to the website to “skip.”  Such a scam.  I’m cancelling.

reviews.title: Scammy app
reviews.text: They enroll you in subscriptions without u even knowing about it

reviews.title: Inconsistent Delivery
reviews.text: Service was great until they changed to their delivery provider. Every week my box is either infinitely delayed and arrives days after the scheduled date full of spoiled food. Also used to be able to chat with a human, now it feels like a useless AI. Fix your delivery provider.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: I used HelloFresh for years and always loved their boxes and the food they’d send, never had any issues. Recently I did have a problem with a box so reached out to their help team but they wouldn’t help at all. I also tried to file a complaint about the issue but apparently they can’t file a complaint either. Now I’m out the money for the box, apparently won’t be getting my food, and they won’t even let me use the discount they’d offered me. This used to be my favorite meal kit service even though it was a bit on the pricier side, but now I have canceled my subscription and will not be using their other kits; EveryPlate, Green Chef, or Factor. There are other kits owned by companies who still care about their customers so don’t bother giving HelloFresh your business.

reviews.title: Misleading orders, terrible custom service
reviews.text: My first box went well, but the second order was a complete mess. I changed my meals and paid extra to move the delivery, yet HelloFresh kept the original meals and wrong date, when I wouldn't even be home. I then asked a human customer service agent to cancel the box, but they didn't cancel it and suddenly closed the chat. The whole experience was misleading, frustrating, and showed just how poor their customer service is. I'm canceling my account and definitely cannot recommend HelloFresh.

Then by 9pm of course it said it was undelivered and couldnt track the parcel. I was then offered a refund to my hello fresh account for my next order 🤣 i said i will not use again and this time i mean it. Genuinely from the bottom of my heart the worst experience and company i have ever dealt with.

reviews.title: Poor Customer service.
reviews.text:
I was excited to try HelloFresh, but unfortunately my experience has been disappointing.

After deciding I no longer wanted to receive another box, I was surprised to find that I was still being charged and sent one. I reached out to customer service hoping to better understand what happened and see if there was anything they could do. I was polite throughout the conversation, but the representative I spoke with was not very understanding or helpful, which made an already frustrating situation even more disappointing.

I was also underwhelmed by the meal selection. While the meals are good, I found that many of the options become repetitive from week to week. If you want more variety or the more appealing meals, you often have to pay an additional charge on top of the subscription price. That makes it difficult to feel like you’re getting good value.

Overall, I expected better customer service and more flexibility with both the ordering process and the meal options. I hope HelloFresh takes customer feedback seriously and works to improve both the customer experience and the variety offered in their meal plans.

I am honestly shocked to see a company that seems to promote such good motives, work so poorly at customer satisfaction. The representative I worked with had also made a point to tell me to “donate the food to a local food bank” if I didn’t wish to receive it. Which would be a great idea except the box “ I didn’t prefer to receive” cost what little money I had for foo

reviews.title: Box kommt, obwohl nicht bestellt wurde
reviews.text: Über Revolut bin ich auf Hello Fresh gekommen und wollte schauen was es dort für Boxen gibt, um meinem Mann etwas Gutes zu tun. Wie das dann so ist, muss man bei der Anmeldung einige Daten eingeben. Worauf ich allerdings nichts hingewiesen wurde, dass ich damit schon ein Abo abschließen werde. Natürlich wurden mir dann Mitten in der Nacht um nach 0 Uhr 39,49 € abgezogen. Ich bin dann direkt auf Hello Fresh, alles gekündigt, weil ich wusste ja quasi erst dann von dem Abo und nach einer Stornierung geschaut, Nichts… So eben rief ich dann beim Kundenservice an, die mir das Geld natürlich nicht zurück erstatten können, da die AGBs dies nicht zulassen, weil die erste Bestellung nicht stornierbar sei. Positiv ist, dass die Box jetzt trotzdem ankommt, negativ ist, dass mir jetzt das Geld fehlt, obwohl ich nichts auf bestellen geklickt habe und ich jetzt Dinge in meiner Box habe, die mein Mann wahrscheinlich nicht verträgt oder wir eventuell gar nicht essen. Ich bin zwar Köchin und kann alles verarbeiten, aber so wollte ich das dennoch nicht haben und fühlte mich kurz wie in einer Abo-Falle, vor allem, weil ich leider nicht daraufhin gewiesen wurde mit den entsprechenden Bannern, wie es der Kundenservice sagte.

reviews.title: Zero reliability and appalling customer service – Left with no food at 9pm!
reviews.text: I ordered from HelloFresh for the very first time last week, selecting a 5-meal box to feed my family for the upcoming week. The box was scheduled for delivery today (Monday). By 9pm, nothing had arrived.I was never sent a notification or warning about a delay. It was only because I proactively initiated a live chat with support that I was finally told my box was not going to be delivered at all.Instead of immediately offering a refund for this massive failure, the agent repeatedly tried to pressure me into waiting until tomorrow so they could "find a solution". I had to firmly demand my money back twice before they finally agreed to process a refund.To make matters worse, HelloFresh has sent zero official email confirmation regarding my refund. Once the chat window closed, my only proof of their agreement vanished. I am now left at 9pm on a Monday night with a hungry family, no groceries, no proof of my refund, and forced to spend extra money on last-minute food. Absolutely terrible first experience. Avoid this company if you actually need your food to arrive.

reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text:
The staff member who came to my home told me he was there to help me set up the HelloFresh app. I specifically informed him that I was not ready to place an order at that time. He assured me that he was only setting up the app and not making any purchases.
However, money was later taken from my account. When I questioned this, I was told that the funds would be returned. Instead, I was notified that I was due to receive a grocery delivery.
I then contacted the HelloFresh customer support team to cancel the order. I was assured that the cancellation would be processed, yet money was still withdrawn from my bank account.
I am extremely disappointed with this experience and feel misled by the entire process. As a first-time customer, this has left me with a very negative impression of the service. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend HelloFresh to others and hope the company takes steps to improve its customer service and sales practices.

reviews.title: App Turned To Garbage
reviews.text: Long time Hello Fresh customer, so well accustomed to the fun and games of missing ingredients (have they ever had a pomegranate?) and/or the smallest sweet potatoes you’ve ever seen. So far, so normal. However, over the past few months, the app has become a total disaster. Picking a few weekly meals has become an ordeal, so much so that I’ve had to ditched the phone and move over to a computer and the website. Menus won’t scroll, or will crash and reload if you try to love beyond the first few meals. And that’s if it’ll let you log in. The most common issue is that I’ve been logged out, and my credentials are refused. These same credentials are then accepted on the website. You don’t expect to find yourself struggling with app crashes, in the same way I didn’t expect to be shopping for the peas you didn’t pack in my recipe kit. Or the limes the week before. Or the avocado.. etc… etc…

reviews.text: Ik vind het nog steeds heel vervelend dat ik steeds op ‘vorige bestellingen’ moet klikken, als ik naar een gerecht wil dat ik nog moet maken. Zorg gewoon dat ik direct in de week zit, waarin we nu zitten.

reviews.title: Recepten fijn, app en site hysterisch instabiel en onpraktisch
reviews.text: Na stoppen van deelmerk Greenchef weer terug bij HF. Best blij met recepten  (veel opties, wel goed zoeken naar dingen met fatsoenlijke hoeveelheid groente, daar waren veel greenchef recepten beter in) Ben tevreden over de andere producten, en de extraatjes zijn leuk. Maar de app en site zijn en blijven bizar instabiel en onhandig. Daar gaat deze tweesterren over. De hele tijd ‘technische problemen’ met app en mobiele site. Vanaf het moment dat de bestelling wordt voorbereid kun je met geen mogelijkheid meer zien welk bezorgblok het ook alweer was, en het allerergst is dat eindeloze pushen om vrienden en kennissen op te zadelen met boxen. Ik ben je klant, niet je marketingvehikel. Ool die ‘snel snel bestel’ mails zijn waanzinnig irritant voor een vaste klant. Geef me de optie die pushes en reclames uit te zetten. Maar maak eerst iets dat niet 1 op de 3 keer ‘technische problemem heeft.

reviews.title: Update werkt niet
reviews.text: Update die stabiliteit belooft, maar vervolgens. Iet werkt.

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: Cannot change meals, for months already.

reviews.title: App still rubbish
reviews.text: I love Hello Fresh, been using it for few years. Really works for me. But….. the app is getting worse. Update hasn’t fixed it. My Menu takes ages to load, if at all (on iPad). Need to sort this out please.

reviews.title: Fix de app
reviews.text: Een update en nu werkt die hele kanker app niet meer. Recepten laden niet, kan geen dingen kiezen voor volgende weken, algehele kankerzooi

reviews.title: App werkt niet
reviews.text: De app werkt al maanden niet. Echt ongelooflijk omdat je ervan afhankelijk bent. De website werkt ook, maar dat verwacht je niet als je zoveel betaald per week.

reviews.title: The App is unpredictable
reviews.text: The app just seems to glitch out every so often, it never used to be that bad. While it’s very straight forward to use when it works, the app has been repeatedly glitchy for the past for months and no update seems to resolve it.

reviews.title: DONT DO IT You will forget to cancel and will pay more! Pay a nutritionist to meal plan for you!!
reviews.text: They make money taking advantage of the fact you might forget to skip a week. It’s not easy, you can’t just ‘turn it off for the foreseeable future’. As a uni student, I probably ‘accidentally’ had to have a £40 delivery 4 times. Oh and don’t get me started on ANY company that has a 2 step account deletion process where you have to remember your email, password and request deletion is 100% profiting off of making services complicated. Regardless of the concept being good, you’re better off paying a nutritionist that £30 a week to hand pick you a meal plan within your budget AND factor in who you are.

reviews.title: Attention, this is thieve
reviews.text: Don't install this app, they'll steal all your money. We blocked their card payments because we couldn't find a way to cancel them, but they still charge me. I had to block my card and throw it away so they'd stop stealing my money.

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: Love the food, love the service. Been with them for years. App hasn’t worked since January. Nothing loads.

reviews.title: Shame they use Evri
reviews.text:
Use to love HelloFresh and the app works well. But not ordered from them since they moved to Evri (parcel lost, damaged or stolen). If they stop use Evri, I’ll happily start ordering again. 
The one issue with the app is if you add a comment to why you’re skipping due to a delivery issue, the app crashes.

reviews.title: Technische storing
reviews.text: Heel blij met de gerechten van HelloFresh. Maar sinds een tijdje is de app bijna niet meer te gebruiken. Iedere keer krijg ik de melding dat er een technische storing is. Hierdoor kan ik geen recepten kiezen, mijn box pauzeren of zien hoe laat de box geleverd wordt. Heel irritant en zonde van dit ooit zo fijne concept.

reviews.title: Great in the past but recent updates ruined it
reviews.text:
This app has been great in the past but recent app updates have rendered it unusable. Nothing works and even selecting upcoming meals (which should be the most basic thing to do!) is broken. 

Updating via the Web for now, but if this continues then it's hard to see people staying subscribed when this is their experience.

reviews.title: Never ever try to register in this scam app
reviews.text: They are taking your money without your permission, i registered after look what they have not order any thing and close the app, after few hours they did order for me without asking me. I ask for cancellation and refunding, after spending two hours conversation they not refund me. So please don’t even download this scam app.

reviews.title: Vooruitgang na update?
reviews.text: Om met de deur in huis te vallen. Wat een slechte update van de app. Inclusie is ver te zoeken. Mijn vrouw heeft jaren lang de app kunnen gebruiken met voice-over. Voor zowel bestellen als het recept voorlezen tijdens koken. Beide is dus na deze update niet meer mogelijk. Gevolg, ik sta standaard nu in de keuken. Nu vind ik dat geen ramp, maar mijn vrouw mag graag ook in de keuken staan. Met HelloFresh wil dat niet meer. Recepten aanpassen in je box is ook een uitdaging geworden in de app. De hele app werkt niet met voiceover en voor mijzelf is met geen mogelijkheid voorgeselecteerde recepten te wisselen voor andere. Als dit niet snel opgelost wordt nemen we afscheid van HelloFresh na 6 jaar. Jammer dit, geen vooruitgang maar achteruitgang.

reviews.title: Geen melding voor de bestelling definitief wordt
reviews.text: De app geeft geen melding de dag voordat de box definitief is, hierdoor kan de box niet meer gewijzigd of afgezegd worden als je de melding ontvangt.

reviews.title: Learn to do math
reviews.text: I’m happy with the meals, recipes etc. but the perks are ridiculous. Say my order costs £48 for the week, and I have £7 off. I add a £7 meal to my order and total cost becomes £62.

reviews.title: So expensive and rubbish
reviews.text: Gusto is so much better. HelloFresh ingredients are great and they are very expensive. Also their customer service is terrible.

reviews.title: Can’t change meals
reviews.text: Unable to change meals. Get an error and then no black box to add quantity. Have to use website instead

reviews.title: Duped! Won’t refund or cancel.
reviews.text:
I saw the Hello Fresh 50% offer, was looking to save money, and refresh my eating habits. When signing up you submit a payment of £1 which is promptly refunded. Once into the App and viewed some of the meals available, I decided that Hello Fresh wasn’t for me. So left the app. 
Thirty minutes  later I received a bank notification of a charge made by Hello Fresh for my first order.
I contacted Hello Fresh and expressed my desire to cancel not just this week, but the next four also that were preselected for me by Hello Fresh. I was told that I would not be able to cancel this weeks and that the delivery and charges will still apply, despite my registration being less than 2 hours old. 
I merely enquired, and was charged without completing the order myself, it was completed automatically by Hello Fresh. Really disappointing that there are still companies out there who entice you in, charge people, and then refuse to refund. I just want to make others before they sign up and are charged also.

reviews.title: disrespectful and low quality
reviews.text: each meal costs about four times as much as just buying the ingredients yourself. i understand that i pay for convenience, but this price is too high. i remember first hearing of hello fresh and it being advertised as a way to save money, and it was. it also used to come with much more recyclable packaging, in my last box the only thing i could put in the recycling bin was the box itself, which was about three times larger than it needed to be, and the three paper bags that some of the ingredients came in, which were also largely oversized. the company model has now turned into a hope that the customer is too late to cancel a box to charge them for just one more. i ordered my last box a day and a half before its arrival and it didn’t seem to be an issue, but all other boxes get paid for five days in advance with no way to cancel? suspicious. i also cancelled my subscription and requested the deletion of my account, and the response was that they’re not going to delete my account because they’re not actually legally required to do so. gross. the app is also very low quality and constantly glitches, once having told me that a box had been cancelled and then i got charged anyway with no way for a refund

reviews.title: Cookbook has disappeared from the app
reviews.text: The Cookbook of archive recipes has disappeared from the app. I’ve bought hundreds of boxes over the years and now I can’t find my favourite recipes when I want to make them again. That’s a step backwards in my view. Been considering cancelling for a while and this has made the final decision for me.

reviews.title: Creepy
reviews.text: Keep sending me letters through the post with offers to resubscribing and no info on stopping this. Never rejoining, what a scam

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: I used to use this service a lot. Just decided to restart again and the ingredients for all three meals have just all been thrown in the box jumbled up. (Used to be in paper bags separated by the meal) I use this kind of service to make life easier not to sieve through a box of a hundred ingredients to try to find the right ones for each meal.

reviews.title: Warning you away from this company

Research them online; food can arrived spoiled, they currently facing multiple lawsuits for misleading consumers, they will spam you endlessly, sign you up to subscriptions without realising, set debt collectors after you

Employees reading this; keep your salary but quiet quit. We all lose when people like this to succeed in our society

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: Cannot follow delivery instructions. Packages repeatedly left in the rain or damaged on delivery. Promises kept been made to take up the issue with delivery agent, but nothing changed.

reviews.title: Onoverzichtelijk
reviews.text: Inmiddels hebben we meer dan 180 HF boxen gehad. De hoeveelheid eten is altijd meer dan genoeg. Ook aan variatie geen gebrek. Er is keuze genoeg. Maar die vernieuwde app is echt een drama. Onoverzichtelijk. Een week overslaan is omslachtig geworden en het overzicht is totaal kwijt. Jammer maar we overwegen nu een box van een andere aanbieder.

reviews.title: Awful service

reviews.title: Never going back
reviews.text: We’ve been hello fresh customers on and off for 7 years. Recently we’ve had a plan to get four meals a week, for 3 people, for $142. Fast forward to today, when a giant box arrived, with 8 meals, and a $250 charge to our account. We thought, easy fix, we’ll call and tell them they sent us double the food and charged us double the price, assuming we would get a refund for whatever error occurred. Instead the customer service agent attempted to gaslight us into saying we had ordered 7 meals. Who orders 7 HelloFresh meals?? We’re feeding two adults and a 7yo. What am I going to do with 9 packages of meat that have to be cooked in 5 days- because the packaging conveniently says you can’t freeze the meat... We offered to send the food back because it says on the package it is only good for 5 days- no, they’re keeping our money and there’s nothing they can do about it. The customer service agent said, “we have it in our system that you ordered 7 meals”. We did not order 7, and we were delivered 8! Clearly their system was wrong… The agent then asked for a screenshot of our HelloFresh account showing we only get four meals. She then said “oh… I can see you only get four meals…”. Long story short, my refrigerator is full of food I won’t have time to cook, my account is $250 less, and HelloFresh can kiss my butthole for having the worst customer service I’ve ever experienced.
